zh: 修复桌面暂停按钮落到圆环下面及发送、暂停相互遮挡的问题。主按钮定位到输入卡片；生成时编辑草稿仍可单独点击暂停，原生输入和手机界面保持独立点击区域，并验证真实任务取消与草稿保留。
en: Fix desktop stop controls landing underneath the context ring and overlapping Send. Anchor primary controls to the input card, keep Stop separately clickable while editing a running conversation, and preserve independent hit areas in native input and on phones. Verify actual cancellation and retained drafts.
